motions.title: Mid Yorkshire Teaching Trust Briefing
motions.full_text: To receive a briefing from Mid Yorkshire Teaching NHS Trust on their key priorities, opportunities and challenges over the next 12 months
motions.opposition_strategy: Opposition may argue that the Trust's plans do not go far enough to address the issues facing the NHS
motions.ruling_group_response: Emphasize the Trust's commitment to improving patient care and the importance of working together to address the challenges facing the NHS

amendment_predictions.amendment_angle: Calling for more drastic action to address the issues facing the NHS
amendment_predictions.counter: Highlight the Trust's existing plans and the importance of allowing them to implement their strategies

motions.title: Care Quality Commission Inspection Outcomes Report
motions.full_text: To provide members with details of recently reported Care Quality Commission inspection outcomes for health and social care providers across the Wakefield District
motions.opposition_strategy: Opposition may argue that the Council is not doing enough to address the issues highlighted by the CQC
motions.ruling_group_response: Emphasize the Council's commitment to working with providers to improve the quality of care and the importance of taking a proactive approach to addressing the issues highlighted by the CQC

amendment_predictions.amendment_angle: Calling for more funding to be allocated to address the issues highlighted by the CQC
amendment_predictions.counter: Highlight the existing funding commitments and the importance of working within existing budgets

key_data_points: Inadequate care at Elm Lodge Residential Care Home

questions.question_text: What is being done to address the funding issues facing the NHS?
recommended_answer_points: Importance of working within existing budgets
questions.trap_explanation: The question may be an attempt to get the ruling group to commit to additional funding

tactical_scenarios.scenario: Opposition attempts to amend a motion to call for more drastic action to address the issues facing the NHS
tactical_scenarios.counter: Highlight the existing plans and the importance of allowing the Trust to implement their strategies

speakers.name: Cllr Padget
key_points: Importance of working together to address the challenges facing the NHS

media_risk_items: CQC Inspection Outcomes Report could generate press coverage

motions.title: Planning Application 25/00865/FUL - Mayfields Way
motions.full_text: Detailed planning application for residential dwellings (up to 104 dwellings) (Use Class C3) with communal public space, associated landscaping, and infrastructure works at land south of Mayfields Way and Parkgate, South Kirkby.
motions.opposition_strategy: Focus on the 64 letters of objection, specifically concerns regarding flooding, drainage, and the loss of greenfield land. They will likely frame this as over-development of the South Kirkby area.
motions.ruling_group_response: Emphasise that the site was specifically removed from the Green Belt in the Local Plan 2036. Highlight that the proposal meets all technical requirements and that the developer has addressed drainage concerns through the planning process.

amendment_predictions.amendment_angle: Attempt to defer the decision pending a new flood risk assessment.
amendment_predictions.counter: Reject as unnecessary. The Service Director has already reviewed the technical data. Use the Chair to rule the amendment as dilatory if it lacks new evidence.

questions.question_text: How can the council approve this given the history of flooding in the area?
recommended_answer_points: The application has been subject to rigorous technical review.
Drainage strategies are conditioned to ensure no net increase in runoff.
The site is allocated for housing in the adopted Local Plan 2036.
questions.trap_explanation: Attempting to force a public admission of local flood vulnerability which could be used to challenge the planning consent in court.

tactical_scenarios.scenario: Opposition attempts to call for a recorded vote on the planning application.
tactical_scenarios.counter: Ensure the Chair is prepared to handle the request according to standing orders. Keep the majority group whipped to ensure the motion passes.

time_management.recommended_time_saving: Strict enforcement of the three-minute speaking rule for all objectors and applicants.

media_risk_items: Approval of greenfield development in South Kirkby

motions.title: Regeneration and Economic Growth
motions.full_text: To receive a briefing on the Regeneration, Environment and Economic Growth Directorate's key priorities to assist the Committee in formulating its 2026/27 work programme.
motions.opposition_strategy: The opposition may argue that the regeneration plans do not adequately address the needs of local communities and businesses.
motions.ruling_group_response: Emphasize the importance of community engagement and the potential economic benefits of the regeneration plans.

amendment_predictions.amendment_angle: Calling for greater emphasis on supporting local businesses
amendment_predictions.counter: Highlight the existing support for local businesses and the potential benefits of the proposed regeneration plans.

motions.title: Communities Service Priorities
motions.full_text: To receive a briefing on the Communities Service's key priorities to assist the Committee in formulating its 2026/27 work programme.
motions.opposition_strategy: The opposition may argue that the Communities Service priorities do not adequately address the needs of vulnerable communities.
motions.ruling_group_response: Emphasize the importance of supporting vulnerable communities and the potential benefits of the proposed service priorities.

amendment_predictions.amendment_angle: Calling for greater emphasis on supporting community groups
amendment_predictions.counter: Highlight the existing support for community groups and the potential benefits of the proposed service priorities.

questions.question_text: What is the expected impact of the regeneration plans on local businesses?
questions.trap_explanation: The question may be attempting to elicit a negative response about the regeneration plans.

questions.question_text: How will the Communities Service priorities address the needs of vulnerable communities?
questions.trap_explanation: The question is a genuine inquiry about the service priorities.

tactical_scenarios.scenario: The opposition attempts to amend the regeneration plans to include greater support for local businesses.
tactical_scenarios.counter: Highlight the existing support for local businesses and the potential benefits of the proposed regeneration plans.

tactical_scenarios.scenario: A member of the public asks a question about the impact of the regeneration plans on local residents.
tactical_scenarios.counter: Emphasize the potential benefits of the regeneration plans for local residents, such as improved amenities and increased job opportunities.

time_management.recommended_time_saving: Use friendly amendments on motions 1 and 2

media_risk_items: Regeneration plans could generate local press coverage
